rationale: The candidate directly identifies `cmd.Flags()` and correctly says it returns a `*flag.FlagSet`. This is supported by `command.go:1641-1653`, whose comment states that `Flags` returns the complete `FlagSet` applying to the command, including local and persistent flags declared there and by all parents. The optional note about `cmd.InheritedFlags()` is also supported by `command.go:1695-1698`, which says it returns flags inherited from parent commands.
